chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Every act of kindness is charity, and the one who guides to goodness is like the one who does it, and Allah loves relieving the distressed."

key_terms.الدَّالُّ: the one who directs or guides others
key_terms.صَدَقَةٌ: charity; a deed counted as charitable giving
key_terms.كَفَاعِلِهِ: like the one who performs it in reward
key_terms.مَعْرُوفٍ: an act of goodness or recognized kindness

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about guiding others to good and helping the distressed?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that all recognized acts of goodness carry the reward and value of charity. It also affirms that guiding others to good shares in the merit of the deed, and that Allah loves helping those in distress.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Every act of kindness is charity, and the one who guides towards goodness is like the one who performs it. Allah (swt) loves the relief of the distressed."
